options.prompt:
Create a realistic, production-quality UI design with clear hierarchy, strong typography and purposeful spacing.
Use case: ui-mockup. Concept name: 큰 글자형.
Design ONE square small home-screen widget for a Korean family parking-location app. Output a square 1024 x 1024 image with exactly one 864 x 864 rounded-square widget centered on a flat #F5F7FA background with 80 px margins. The widget represents a real 170 x 170 logical-point small widget, enlarged uniformly for this presentation. Widget width MUST equal height. Radius 145px at output scale. Front view, no perspective, no device bezel, no phone, no OS status bar, no outer title or annotation. No collage.
The attached screenshot is visual grounding for the existing app's typography, palette, location data hierarchy. It is NOT an edit target: design only the square widget. Use the existing palette #1E293B dark slate, #DBEAFE pale blue, #CBD5E1 muted slate, white. Korean typography like Noto Sans KR, Latin figures bold clean rounded sans. No green/lime, gradients, illustrations, map, car photo, glass, fake live indicator or decorative metrics. Never include the app name or license plate.
Widget design: solid dark slate #1E293B. A remarkably clear typographic widget with 16pt-equivalent internal margins. Upper-left large white "B2" at about 66pt-equivalent, dominating the composition, with a tiny understated location pin outline in the top-right. Directly below B2, "C구역 · 24번" in pale blue at 19pt bold. Spacious lower breathing room, then bottom-left muted footer "11.6 18:42 갱신" at 10.5pt. No buttons on this concept. Everything is left aligned in one clean vertical stack; location can be read instantly at a glance.
Current date anchor: 2026-11-06 Asia/Seoul. Example timestamp is 2026-11-06 18:42, preserve the exact short text above. These are visual sample data, no claimed live connectivity. Render Korean text accurately. Do not add additional texts, badges, controls or labels. Ensure only one square widget and exact clean spacing.

Design ONE square small home-screen widget for a Korean family parking-location app. Output a square 1024 x 1024 image with exactly one 864 x 864 rounded-square widget centered on a flat #F5F7FA background with 80 px margins. The attached screenshot is visual grounding for the existing app palette and readable typography only. It is NOT an edit target. Create a new contained small square widget rather than the full app screenshot.
Concept: a restrained modern parking pass. One pale-blue #DBEAFE square with slate #1E293B typography. A tiny "P" symbol at upper left and small "주차 위치" beside it, no brand name. Beneath this minimal header, the main location uses two balanced rows: a large bold "B2" with small "지하 2층" aligned to its right; next line very prominent "C · 24" with a small subordinate "구역 · 번호" underneath. A thin dark-slate hairline divider above the footer. At bottom, "11.6 18:42 갱신" at 10.5pt-equivalent. Clean Swiss-inspired alignment, more orderly sign/parking-pass structure than a giant single floor. Maintain 16pt-equivalent interior padding and legibility at actual small-widget size. No buttons.
Existing product uses Noto Sans KR Regular/Bold, restrained slate and pale blue. Only this established palette: #DBEAFE #1E293B #526176 #F5F7FA. No green/lime, gradients, shadows, paper texture, decorative cutouts, illustrations, map, car photo, QR code, barcode, fake live indicator. No app name or license plate, no additional UI or text.
Current date anchor 2026-11-06 Asia/Seoul. All data are design examples: floor B2, zone C, space 24, timestamp 11.6 18:42. Render exact Korean glyphs and no mistakes. One visually crisp TRUE SQUARE widget only.

Create a realistic, production-quality UI design with clear hierarchy, strong typography and purposeful spacing.

Design ONE square small home-screen widget for a Korean family parking-location app. Output a square 1024 x 1024 image with exactly one 864 x 864 rounded-square widget centered on flat #F5F7FA with 80px margins. Front view, no perspective, no device, no phone, no OS status bar, outer title or annotation. No collage.
Attached screenshot is visual grounding only for existing app typography and palette. This is a brand-new square widget, not an edit of that screenshot.
Concept: distinctly structured two-column location readout. Upper 76% of widget is split vertically with no gap: left 54% dark slate #1E293B, right 46% pale blue #DBEAFE. This is ONE joined square widget with one outer radius; no nested cards. Left panel: tiny pale "층" at upper-left, a huge white "B2" vertically centered, small "지하 2층" near bottom of panel. Existing design tokens only: #1E293B dark slate, #DBEAFE pale blue, #CBD5E1 muted text and white. Typography Noto Sans KR Regular/Bold with crisp sans numerals. No green/lime, gradients, illustrations, maps, car art, shadows, glass, app name, license plate, live status or extra metrics.

Use case: ui-mockup. Concept name: 빠른 기록형.
Design ONE square small home-screen widget for a Korean family parking-location app. Output a square 1024 x 1024 image with exactly one 864 x 864 rounded-square widget centered on flat #F5F7FA with 80px margins. It represents a 170 x 170 logical-point small widget enlarged uniformly. Widget width MUST equal height, rounded corners around 145px at output scale. Front view, no perspective, no device bezel, phone, OS status bar, outer title or annotation. No collage.
Attached screenshot is visual grounding for existing app tokens and typography. Create a new square widget, not a full app screen and not an edit of the attached screenshot.
Concept: location plus one clear record shortcut, with no cramped controls. Solid #1E293B dark-slate widget. Internal padding about 15pt-equivalent.
Upper content uses a neat compact two-column row: at left "B2" in white bold at 48pt-equivalent. At right, vertically centered, "C구역" at 16pt bold with "24번" immediately below at 14pt regular. No column backgrounds and no divider, just whitespace. Under this main location row, left-aligned "11.6 18:42 갱신" in muted #CBD5E1 at 10pt. In the bottom portion, a pale-blue #DBEAFE pill spanning almost full interior width, exactly 44pt-equivalent high, with a clean plus outline icon and centered dark-slate bold Korean label "주차 기록" at 14pt. This is a shortcut to the app's parking entry form; do not imply saving immediately or add "saved" confirmation. A single meaningful action only.
The location must remain the visual hero. Keep healthy spacing between location, timestamp and the pill. The complete content must fit naturally inside the true square at 170pt size. No floor selector grid, no secondary actions. Noto Sans KR Regular/Bold and clean rounded sans numerals. No app name, no license plate, no promotional words, no live/synced badge, no illustrations/maps/car photos, no green/lime, gradients, glass or shadows.
Current date anchor 2026-11-06 Asia/Seoul. Exact example location B2 / C구역 / 24번, exact timestamp "11.6 18:42 갱신", exact action label "주차 기록". Korean text must be accurate.
